Team Securicor + Listerine: Vic Lee Racing runs two BMW M3s with Listerine backing. Will Hoy and Ray Bellm drive.
Vauxhall Dealersport: Dave Cook Racing runs the works Vauxhall Cavaliers. The car already raced in 1990.
Kaliber ICS Team Toyota: Andy Rouse Engineering runs two Toyota Carinas for Toyota.
Mobil BMW Team: Prodrive runs the factory BMW M3s. Steve Soper shares car 44 when he is free from the DTM.
Team Labatt's: The second Vic Lee Racing pair of BMW M3s, with Labatt's backing.
Graham Goode Racing: A privateer two-litre Ford Sierra in grey and blue for Andy Middlehurst.
Shell Team Trakstar Ford: Robb Gravett's own team. It is the only Ford entry with manufacturer status.
Pyramid Motorsport: A privateer BMW team set up by BMW dealers. Frank Sytner drives most of the year. Matt Neal makes his BTCC debut in its second car at Silverstone.
Nissan Racing with Castrol: Janspeed runs the new Nissan Primera from round 2. A second car joins late in the year.
BMW Dealer Team Sweden: Swedish BMW dealers send two M3s to Britain. Nettan Lindgren and Peggen Andersson drive in the early rounds.
Judge Developments + Partservice: Dennis Leech races his Ford Sierra RS500 for Judge Developments. The Group A car runs with limits to match the new two litre cars.
Techspeed Midland Auto Trader: Tech-Speed was founded in 1984 and builds BMW M3s for other teams. It runs two cars for Nick Whale and Nick Baird with Auto Trader backing.
Mitsubishi Motors + Firestone: Mitsubishi's single car. It starts the year as a Lancer and becomes a Galant.
BRR Motorsport: A small privateer team with one BMW M3. Ian Flux drives most of its races.
R&D Motorsport: A privateer team with a BMW 318is. It is the smallest car on the grid.
HWR Motorsport: Jeff Wilson and Brian Holliday founded HWR in 1978. Wilson races a Vauxhall Belmont he prepares himself.
Drambuie + Lazerprinz: Ian Forrest runs his own BMW M3 with Drambuie backing. He pays for the season with a bank loan.
Brodie Brittain Racing: Dave Brodie and Ken Brittain set up BBR in Brackley. They are turbo specialists. Brodie races a four wheel drive Ford Sierra Sapphire from Brands Hatch on.
